purpose: Pinned record of the minimal RunPod GraphQL surface used for INTERRUPTIBLE (spot) acquisition. The REST v2 contract (runpod_v2_openapi.json) has no interruptible surface; podRentInterruptable is the only supported programmatic path to spot pods.

provenance.live_introspection: DISABLED on https://api.runpod.io/graphql (Apollo INTROSPECTION_DISABLED, verified 2026-08-17); the mutation input contract therefore cannot be verified by a read-only call

enforcement.query_surface: live-verified by executing the pinned queries during preflight; Apollo validates every document against the schema before execution, so an unknown field errors instead of returning data
enforcement.mutation_surface: pinned-only; a drifted PodRentInterruptableInput fails the authorized launch closed with a pre-execution validation error — no pod is created, nothing is billed

interruptible_semantics.purchase: podRentInterruptable bids bidPerGpu USD/h; the pod runs while the bid holds capacity
interruptible_semantics.eviction: spot pods receive SIGTERM ~5s before SIGKILL; the pod is STOPPED (REST status EXITED), not terminated, and may later be resumed by re-bidding (lowestBidPriceToResume)
interruptible_semantics.session_policy: this session never resumes an evicted pod in place: container disk state is treated as lost, the remnant is terminated, and a fresh qualifying pod is acquired (bounded by budget and max_pod_creations); durable state lives off-pod via continuous artifact sync
interruptible_semantics.rest_visibility_assumption: a spot pod appears as a normal pod on REST v2 (GET /v2/pods, logs, DELETE); exercised against the mock, LIVE-HARDWARE-UNVALIDATED until the first real spot pod — the GraphQL myself.pods query is reconciled as a redundant second surface
